topic.title: Topic Names
topic.description: Comma separated list of Kafka topic names

bootstrapServers.title: Bootstrap Servers
bootstrapServers.description: Comma separated list of Kafka Broker URLs

saslAuthType.title: Authentication Type
saslAuthType.description: Authentication type to use. Use NONE for no authentication, PLAIN or SCRAM_SHA_256/SCRAM_SHA_512 for username/password, SSL for certificate-based, OAUTH for OAuth 2.0, AWS_MSK_IAM for MSK, or KERBEROS for Kerberos.

saslUsername.title: Username
saslUsername.description: Username for SASL authentication. Required when saslAuthType is PLAIN, SCRAM_SHA_256, or SCRAM_SHA_512.

saslPassword.title: Password
saslPassword.description: Password for SASL authentication. Required when saslAuthType is PLAIN, SCRAM_SHA_256, or SCRAM_SHA_512.

oauthClientId.title: OAuth Client ID
oauthClientId.description: OAuth client ID. Required when saslAuthType is OAUTH.

oauthClientSecret.title: OAuth Client Secret
oauthClientSecret.description: OAuth client secret. Required when saslAuthType is OAUTH.

oauthTokenEndpointUri.title: OAuth Token Endpoint
oauthTokenEndpointUri.description: OAuth token endpoint URI. Required when saslAuthType is OAUTH.

oauthScope.title: OAuth Scope
oauthScope.description: OAuth scope. Optional when saslAuthType is OAUTH.

sslTruststoreLocation.title: SSL Truststore Location
sslTruststoreLocation.description: The location of the trust store file.

sslTruststorePassword.title: SSL Truststore Password
sslTruststorePassword.description: The password for the trust store file.

sslKeystoreLocation.title: SSL Keystore Location
sslKeystoreLocation.description: The location of the key store file. Used for mTLS authentication.

sslKeystorePassword.title: SSL Keystore Password
sslKeystorePassword.description: The password for the key store file.

sslKeyPassword.title: SSL Key Password
sslKeyPassword.description: The password of the private key in the key store file.
